SELECT l.LOG_NO AS logNo, t.TITLE AS title, l.DUTY AS duty, u.USER_NAME AS userName, u.EMAIL AS email, l.INPUT_DATE AS inputDate FROM TODOLOG l LEFT JOIN TODO t ON l.TODO_NO = t.TODO_NO LEFT JOIN USERS u ON t.USER_NO = u.USER_NO
AND u.COMPANY_NO = #{companyNo}
AND l.INPUT_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND l.INPUT_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND t.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{title} || '%'
AND l.DUTY LIKE '%' || #{task} || '%'
AND u.USER_NAME = #{userName, typeHandler=kr.co.sist.login.EncryptTypeHandler}
ORDER BY l.INPUT_DATE DESC
